metadata.source_note: Exact original BZSt-authored DA-KG Stand 2025 PDF retained by the mirror. Its bytes match axiom-oracles de-subject-003 and all 2025 DA-KG ledger rows (SHA-256 33e1a8c4f6bd65034febc9d0c45850e64e982f665f519f08eaeceb80ac02dedd). The live legacy BZSt endpoint now supplies Stand 2026 with a different hash, so no claim of a current government-hosted 2025 capture is made. Full source PDF retained; this row contains complete A 19.2 paragraphs 1 and 2 only, selected by exact page anchors. Edition date records capture date, not legal commencement or issuance; edition year identifies the historic text. The rule limits the evidence period and distinguishes card expiry from award termination; substantive eligibility remains separate.
metadata.title: DA-KG Stand 2025 A 19.2 — Nachweis der Behinderung
